issue_records.title: `FacetValues` not fully implemented for gemetry dimension != interpolation dimension (2D line element)
issue_records.body_excerpt:
I've encountered a bug within `FacetValues`, where I have a 2D line. It seems that `weighted_normal` is not implemented for that case. 
A minimal example is given here: 

```julia
using Ferrite

_grid = generate_grid(Line, (2,), Vec((0.0,)), Vec((1.0)))
nodes = [(n.x[1], 0.0) |> Vec{2} |> Node for n in _grid.nodes]
grid = Grid(_grid.cells, nodes)

ip = Lagrange{RefLine, 1}()
ipGeo = Lagrange{RefLine, 1}()^2

fqr = FacetQuadratureRule{RefLine}(2)
fv = FacetValues(fqr, ip, ipGeo)

fc = FacetCache(grid);
Ferrite.reinit!(fc, FaceIndex((1, 2)))
Ferrite.reinit!(fv, fc)
``` 

throws 
```julia
ERROR: MethodError: no method matching weighted_normal(::StaticArraysCore.SMatrix{2, 1, Float64, 2}, ::Type{RefLine}, ::Int64)
The function `weighted_normal` exists, but no method is defined for this combination of argument types.

Closest candidates are:
  weighted_normal(::Tensor{2, 1, T}, ::Type{RefLine}, ::Int64) where T
   @ Ferrite C:\Users\ac136110\.julia\packages\Ferrite\xAVKU\src\FEValues\facet_integrals.jl:85
  weighted_normal(::Tensor{2, 3}, ::Type{RefPyramid}, ::Int64)
   @ Ferrite C:\Users\ac136110\.julia\packages\Ferrite\xAVKU\src\FEValues\facet_integrals.jl:294
  weighted_normal(::Tensor{2, 3}, ::Type{RefPrism}, ::Int64)
   @ Ferrite C:\Users\ac136110\.julia\packages\Ferrite\xAVKU\src\FEValues\facet_integrals.jl:257
  ...
```

traceability_evidence.commit_message:
fix `weighted_normal` for embedded lines (#1235)

Makes `reinit!` of `FacetValues` work for embedded line elements.
Closes #1226
